title: Whose cold was it?
setting: A weekday evening. Okaasan, in bed with a cold, leaves Yuki a voicemail about the weekend. Later Yuki calls back and gets Okaasan's voicemail too.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: moshimoshi, yuki? okaasan da kedo. kenji ga ne, kaze hiichatta no.
lines.ja: もしもし、ユキ？お母さんだけど。ケンジがね、風邪ひいちゃったの。
lines.kana: もしもし、ゆき？おかあさんだけど。けんじがね、かぜひいちゃったの。
lines.english: Hello, Yuki? It's Mum. So, Kenji's gone and caught a cold.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: de, kenji no kaze, okaasan ni mo utsutchatta no. nodo ga itakute.
lines.ja: で、ケンジの風邪、お母さんにもうつっちゃったの。のどが痛くて。
lines.kana: で、けんじのかぜ、おかあさんにもうつっちゃったの。のどがいたくて。
lines.english: And now I've caught Kenji's cold too. My throat's so sore.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: yuki, kono shuumatsu, uchi ni kaette kuru tte itteta yo ne?
lines.ja: ユキ、この週末、うちに帰ってくるって言ってたよね？
lines.kana: ゆき、このしゅうまつ、うちにかえってくるっていってたよね？
lines.english: Yuki, you said you were coming home this weekend, didn't you?

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: demo, kaette konaide ne. kitara, yuki ni mo utsuru yo.
lines.ja: でも、帰ってこないでね。来たら、ユキにもうつるよ。
lines.kana: でも、かえってこないでね。きたら、ゆきにもうつるよ。
lines.english: Don't come, though, okay? If you do, you'll catch it too.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: a, daijoubu yo. byouki ni natta wake ja nakute, chotto taichou kuzushita dake.
lines.ja: あ、大丈夫よ。病気になったわけじゃなくて、ちょっと体調崩しただけ。
lines.kana: あ、だいじょうぶよ。びょうきになったわけじゃなくて、ちょっとたいちょうくずしただけ。
lines.english: Oh, we're all right. We haven't fallen ill or anything, we're just a bit under the weather.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: kenji wa ne, kaze hiiteru noni aisu mittsu mo tabete, onaka mo kowashita no yo.
lines.ja: ケンジはね、風邪ひいてるのにアイス三つも食べて、お腹も壊したのよ。
lines.kana: けんじはね、かぜひいてるのにあいすみっつもたべて、おなかもこわしたのよ。
lines.english: And Kenji, cold and all, went and ate three ice creams, so now he's got an upset stomach too.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: yuki mo, shigoto bakkari shiteru to, byouki ni naru yo.
lines.ja: ユキも、仕事ばっかりしてると、病気になるよ。
lines.kana: ゆきも、しごとばっかりしてると、びょうきになるよ。
lines.english: And you, Yuki: if all you ever do is work, you'll make yourself ill.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.ja: 風邪ひかないでね。じゃあね。
lines.kana: かぜひかないでね。じゃあね。
lines.english: Don't you go catching a cold. Bye.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: moshimoshi, okaasan? yuki da kedo. neteru no kana.
lines.ja: もしもし、お母さん？ユキだけど。寝てるのかな。
lines.kana: もしもし、おかあさん？ゆきだけど。ねてるのかな。
lines.english: Hello, Mum? It's Yuki. You're probably asleep.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: kenji, aisu mittsu mo tabeta no? sore wa onaka kowasu yo.
lines.ja: ケンジ、アイス三つも食べたの？それはお腹壊すよ。
lines.kana: けんじ、あいすみっつもたべたの？それはおなかこわすよ。
lines.english: Kenji ate three ice creams? Well, of course his stomach's upset.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: de ne, senshuu kaetta toki, watashi, chotto taichou kuzushiteta yo ne?
lines.ja: でね、先週帰った時、私、ちょっと体調崩してたよね？
lines.kana: でね、せんしゅうかえったとき、わたし、ちょっとたいちょうくずしてたよね？
lines.english: And, um... when I came home last week, I was a bit under the weather, remember?

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: watashi no kaze, kenji ni utsutchatta n da to omou. gomen ne. odaiji ni.
lines.ja: 私の風邪、ケンジにうつっちゃったんだと思う。ごめんね。お大事に。
lines.kana: わたしのかぜ、けんじにうつっちゃったんだとおもう。ごめんね。おだいじに。
lines.english: I think Kenji caught my cold. Sorry. Get well soon.

questions.english: What happens in these two voicemails?

choices.english: Okaasan asks Yuki to come home this weekend and look after Kenji, who is ill in bed.
Yuki can't come home this weekend because she has a cold, and she doesn't want to give it to Kenji.
Okaasan tells Yuki not to come home so she won't catch the family's cold, and Yuki replies that Kenji probably caught it from her in the first place.

questions.explanation: Lines 1-2: Kenji caught a cold (kenji ga ne, kaze hiichatta no) and Okaasan caught it from him (okaasan ni mo utsutchatta no). Lines 3-4: Yuki was due home this weekend, but Okaasan tells her not to come (kaette konaide ne), or she'll catch it too (kitara, yuki ni mo utsuru yo). Lines 11-12: Yuki was run down when she came home last week, and she thinks her cold spread to Kenji (watashi no kaze, kenji ni utsutchatta n da to omou). A is wrong: Okaasan asks her not to come (line 4). B is wrong: it's Okaasan who calls off the visit, and Yuki's cold was last week (line 11: kuzushiteta), already passed on to Kenji (line 12).

questions.english: Okaasan phones you and hears your croaky voice. She asks, "e, sono koe, dou shita no?" (Oh, what's happened to your voice?) Tell her you've caught a cold.
questions.kana: え、そのこえ、どうしたの？
questions.romaji: e, sono koe, dou shita no?
questions.answer: Say you've caught a cold with kaze and hiku, in the past: kaze hiichatta.

modelAnswers.romaji: un, kinou kara kaze hiiteru n da.
modelAnswers.ja: うん、昨日から風邪ひいてるんだ。
modelAnswers.english: Yeah, I've had a cold since yesterday.

questions.explanation: A cold is 'pulled' with hiku, not caught with toru or tsukamu (catching a ball). Kaze hiichatta is how Okaasan breaks the news about Kenji in line 1. Kaze hiiteru (line 6: kaze hiiteru noni) is having a cold right now, so kinou kara kaze hiiteru is 'I've had a cold since yesterday'. Kaze ga utsutta would only fit if you were saying who gave it to you.

questions.english: You have a cold, and Yuki asks, "kaze? doko de hiita no?" (A cold? Where did you pick that up?) Your friend had one last week. Tell her you caught it from your friend.
questions.answer: Say your friend's cold spread to you, with kaze ga utsuru: tomodachi no kaze ga utsutta n da.

modelAnswers.romaji: tomodachi no kaze ga utsutta n da.
modelAnswers.ja: 友達の風邪がうつったんだ。
友達からうつっちゃった。
modelAnswers.english: I caught it off a friend.

questions.explanation: Kaze o hiku is just getting a cold. When it comes from someone, the cold moves to you: kaze ga utsuru, with no or kara for whose it was. Okaasan says it in line 2 (kenji no kaze, okaasan ni mo utsutchatta) and Yuki in line 12 (watashi no kaze, kenji ni utsutchatta). Yuki asked with hiita, but kaze hiita on its own wouldn't say where it came from.

questions.english: Okaasan tells Yuki that she and Kenji haven't 'byouki ni natta'. What does she mean?
questions.ja: お母さんとケンジは、大丈夫なんですか？
questions.kana: おかあさんとけんじは、だいじょうぶなんですか？
questions.romaji: okaasan to kenji wa, daijoubu na n desu ka?

choices.english: It's nothing serious: they've come down with something, but it isn't a real illness.
They haven't seen a doctor yet, so they don't know what illness it is.
They were ill last week, but they've both got better now.

questions.explanation: Line 5: byouki ni natta wake ja nakute, chotto taichou kuzushita dake. Byouki ni naru sounds like falling properly ill, so Okaasan says it isn't that; they're just a bit run down (taichou kuzushita) with a cold and an upset stomach (lines 2 and 6). B is wrong: she never mentions a doctor, and she knows it's Kenji's cold. C is wrong: her throat is still sore (line 2: nodo ga itakute); last week is when Yuki was run down (line 11).

questions.english: You missed work yesterday with a passing bug. Yuki asks, "kinou inakatta ne. dou shita no?" (You weren't in yesterday. What happened?) Tell her you were a bit under the weather.
questions.ja: 昨日いなかったね。どうしたの？
questions.kana: きのういなかったね。どうしたの？
questions.romaji: kinou inakatta ne. dou shita no?
questions.answer: Say you came down with something minor, with taichou and kuzusu: chotto taichou kuzushichatte.

modelAnswers.ja: ちょっと体調崩しちゃって。
modelAnswers.english: I came down with a little something.

modelAnswers.romaji: chotto taichou kuzushite ne. demo, mou daijoubu.
modelAnswers.ja: ちょっと体調崩してね。でも、もう大丈夫。
modelAnswers.english: I was a bit under the weather. I'm fine now, though.

questions.explanation: For a passing bug, the everyday explanation is taichou (o) kuzushita, as in line 5 (chotto taichou kuzushita dake) and line 11 (chotto taichou kuzushiteta). Byouki ni natta would sound like a real illness and worry her. Taichou ga warukatta only describes how you felt; kuzusu is coming down with it.

questions.english: Okaasan says Kenji ate three ice creams even though he has a cold. What does she say happened to his stomach?
questions.ja: お母さんは、ケンジのお腹について何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: おかあさんは、けんじのおなかについてなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: okaasan wa, kenji no onaka ni tsuite nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: his stomach got run down too

choices.romaji: onaka mo byouki ni natta no yo

questions.explanation: Line 6: onaka mo kowashita no yo. The stomach is 'broken' with kowasu, with Kenji as the one who broke it; mo stands in for o, meaning his stomach too, on top of the cold. Yuki says it again in line 10 (sore wa onaka kowasu yo). A is wrong: kuzusu goes with taichou, your health in general (line 5: taichou kuzushita); for the stomach it's kowasu. C is wrong: byouki ni naru is for a person falling properly ill, not a stomach, and Okaasan has just said this isn't a real illness (line 5).

newWords.english: three (things); mittsu mo = as many as three
when, (at) the time (kaetta toki = when I came home)
get well soon, take care (said to someone who's ill)
